content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Lemon squeezy

Lemon Squeezy provides an intuitive platform for selling digital products with built-in payment processing, but its geographical limitations inhibit access for many creators in developing countries. In contrast, COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack is designed with infrastructure sovereignty in mind, utilizing free hosting solutions like Cloudflare Pages and robust tools such as Supabase for order management. This stack enables digital creators to establish a fully operational online store without dependency on restrictive platforms, ensuring autonomy and ownership over their products and data.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Lemon Squeezy and similar platforms often impose geographic restrictions, leaving creators in countries like Nigeria and Pakistan without viable options for selling digital products. These restrictions stem from compliance and risk management protocols that protect the platforms but disenfranchise many creators. Conversely, COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure allows creators from these regions to bypass conventional barriers, deploying a fully functional digital store with automatic crypto payment processing, thus eliminating reliance on platforms that exclude them.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Traditional platforms like PayPal can suspend accounts and hold funds for up to 180 days, creating financial uncertainty for creators. In contrast, the Edge Commerce Stack utilizes NOWPayments, offering rapid on-chain crypto payment verification with a transparent fee structure of only 0.5%. This low-cost, efficient payment processing solution allows creators to receive funds instantly, ensuring they maintain cash flow and liquidity without the fear of arbitrary suspensions or excessive fees.
Sovereign infrastructure ensures you own everything — no dependencies.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With platforms like Lemon Squeezy, creators often face constraints regarding ownership of their digital products and customer data. The Edge Commerce Stack, however, guarantees complete ownership post-deployment, meaning that creators maintain control over their intellectual property and customer interactions. This architecture not only automates payment processing and product delivery but also ensures that creators can operate independently without the limitations or risks associated with traditional platforms.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For creators in restricted countries, the choice between Lemon Squeezy and COREMERCH's infrastructure is clear. If you need a quick setup without the ability to operate freely, Lemon Squeezy may seem appealing. However, if you prioritize ownership, independence, and a robust payment processing structure, the Edge Commerce Stack is the superior option. It empowers creators to establish a sustainable digital business that is resilient against geographic limitations and platform restrictions.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Avoid payment processing suspensions with immediate crypto transactions.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
